notes: General word-order synonym: HOMBA names thalamic nuclei as 'X nucleus of thalamus' while atlases often write 'X thalamic nucleus' (e.g. ventral medial/lateral/anterior/posterior/lateral posterior). Bidirectional.
Cranial-nerve plural/article variant: 'roots of the X nerve' = HOMBA 'root of X nerve' (facial/abducens/trigeminal/etc).
Standard short name for HOMBA:12235 median raphe nucleus.
Standard short name for HOMBA:12642 raphe magnus nucleus.
Standard short name for HOMBA:12643 raphe obscurus nucleus.
Latin word-order variant of HOMBA:12540 ambiguus nucleus (nucleus ambiguus is the conventional name).
Short form of HOMBA:12615 prepositus hypoglossal nucleus (nucleus prepositus hypoglossi).
Heschl's gyrus = HOMBA:12144 transverse temporal gyrus (Heschl's gyrus).
Apostrophe-normalized Heschl's gyrus = transverse temporal gyrus.
Latin plural/spelling variant of HOMBA:12179 limen insula.
ceruleus/coeruleus spelling variant: subceruleus = HOMBA:12500 subcoeruleus nucleus.
Infundibulum (pituitary stalk) = HOMBA:10643 infundibular stalk.
Short form of HOMBA:12497 reticulotegmental nucleus.
Inferior pulvinar (PuI) = HOMBA:10413 inferior division of pulvinar.
zone/nucleus synonym for HOMBA:12620 intermediate reticular nucleus.
Latin/English variant: '-fascicle' = '-fasciculus' (e.g. medial longitudinal fascicle/fasciculus). Bidirectional.
Atlas short form 'Caudate Head' = HOMBA:10335 head of caudate nucleus.
Atlas short form 'Caudate Body' = HOMBA:10336 body of caudate nucleus.
Atlas short form 'Caudate Tail' = HOMBA:10337 tail of caudate nucleus.
Short form 'Accumbens' = HOMBA:10339 nucleus accumbens.
'visual area' = 'visual cortex' for primary/secondary visual regions (V1/V2). Bidirectional.
'auditory area' = 'auditory cortex' for primary/secondary auditory regions (A1/A2). Bidirectional.
'somatosensory area' = 'somatosensory cortex' (S1/S2). Bidirectional.
Nucleus of the solitary tract / solitary tract nucleus = HOMBA:12557 solitary nucleus.
Subparafascicular nucleus = HOMBA:13054 subparafascicular nucleus of thalamus.
Reticular thalamus = HOMBA:10464 reticular nucleus of thalamus (thalamic reticular nucleus).
Common misspelling: occulomotor = oculomotor (maps 'Occulomotor Nuclei' -> oculomotor nucleus HOMBA:12198).

Lateral superior olive (LSO) = HOMBA:12469 lateral superior olivary nucleus.
